verdict.rationale: Gecko's PR-checks docs say it posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab so reviewers see security status inline. The check has a configurable fail-on severity threshold and separates findings the PR introduces from pre-existing ones, and PRs also get a security review summary. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR check/comment behavior, and no detail on per-line inline comments or GitLab-specific merge-request presentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see scan findings surfaced as pull-request comments or checks in GitHub or GitLab

citations.quote: Gecko posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab so reviewers see the security status inline.
